findings: S2: 01-PRD.md carries TEN must-have features, not the 3-6 this check asks for. config/corpus-targets.yaml `companion_feature_cap: [6, 10]` raises the cap for a companion-backed task and stage-1-derive.md routes this task to variant b for the same reason; ten is the top of that band. The out-of-scope list is present.

S5: 04-uiux-brief.md carries no hex palette, no millisecond duration and no cubic-bezier, which this check asks for. generate_instruction.md 'The number rule, DECIDED (A5)' and tools/source_lint.py (G51) forbid a hex anywhere in the corpus text and forbid a duration in the design brief. The exact type families and the exact rendered sizes ARE carried, as the same rule requires, together with the 4.5:1 and 3:1 accessibility bars and a committed light mode.

S6: 05-backend-schema.md states each rule as an observable invariant (a chapter whose published flag is false is served by no public route; section positions stay contiguous from one after any reorder; one trial signup per address) rather than as a named index or constraint. INV9 and tools/prescription_lint.py (G43) forbid naming the storage-engine construct; the observable form is what the pytest layer asserts.

A1: `## Build plan` is absent. generate_instruction.md 2.1 makes Build plan NOT baseline, and `[metadata].spec_sections_given` correspondingly omits `buildplan`. The ten emitted H2s plus the optional `## Front-end specification` are present and canonically spelled, and contract_lint.py (G4) reads the Deployment contract clean.

B3: the third lever (`## Build plan`) is deliberately not emitted, for the reason recorded against A1. `## Technical requirements` and `## Data model` are both present, which is the lever set 2.1 defines at this variant.

C4: `## UI/UX notes` carries the three exact type families and the exact rendered size scale, which this check reads as a numeric recipe. The settled number rule carries type exactly and forbids hex, milliseconds, cubic-bezier and breakpoint pixels; the brief holds none of those four, and source_lint.py (G51) confirms it carries no hex while describing all 31 of the companion's colours by family, tone and shade. The `4.5:1` and `3:1` ratios are accessibility floors, which the same rule writes out.

C5: `## Data model` names no storage-engine construct, because INV9 and G43 forbid it. Each rule is stated as the observable invariant instead, and the derived-rather-than-stored paragraph and the idempotent-seeding line are both present.

C7: `## Core features` is about 15,500 characters and the joined six about 37,600, past the judge's 2,500 and 9,000 slices. generate_instruction.md 4 retired the section budget and window_lint.py (G33) reports length without failing it; the tasker asked for the cap to be ignored on this bundle. The rules past the cut still reach the agent in full and are graded by the pytest layer and the browser channel; what they lose is the advisory judge score, which never touches reward.

D5: two deliberate departures from the companion, neither an inversion. (1) The companion's section 2.1 lists `/404` as a path that renders the not-found shell; the brief instead has every unknown address render that body AND answer not-found, because an address named `/404` answering a success status is a broken not-found page. (2) The companion says the site is not an application a visitor logs into; the brief keeps that sentence for the visitor and adds an author surface behind sign-in, which the companion's own section 20.1 `published` flag already implies and which the content-publishing pattern row requires. Both are recorded in _spec/<code>/00-decisions.md.

RC-10: the rubric carries no negative criterion, so there is nothing for this check to read. The brief's forbidden behaviours (a reveal that replays forward, a stepped colour switch, a draft served at its own address) are graded as positives by the browser channel and by the pytest layer instead, which is where each of them is observable.

RC-12: R13 grades whether each rendered poster caption pairs a tone word with an application word on the colour chapter. The stored caption strings are a different part of that ask and are already graded deterministically by test_seeded_captions_are_stored_in_order; channel_lint.py (G28/G29) reports no collision, and no committed assertion reads the rendered pairing.

RC-15: converged on cycle 2. Cycle 1 carried a bare pronoun in R11 and four criteria that named no surface; both classes were repaired and cycle 2 was clean on rubric_lint.py, rubric_context_lint.py and rubric_align_lint.py together.

SCHEMA-011: task.toml carries a `[delivery]` table, which the canonical template in this prompt does not list. 01-OUTPUT-CONTRACT.md CON-2 and stage-4-task-toml.md require `[delivery]` on every schema-1.4 bundle and validate_task.py (G2) validates it. `[delivery.images]` is omitted deliberately: CON-2 wants a `@sha256:` digest per image while reference/C C.4 forbids a single-architecture child digest and forbids a fabricated one, and no registry is reachable from this run to resolve a manifest-list digest. The validator treats an absent images table as legal.

TAX-006 / TAX-008 / BENCH-002 / INST-007 are NOT-APPLICABLE: the task is non-trivial and `language` is `python` rather than `any`; archetype uniqueness is the mint ledger's to enforce and cannot be decided from one file; and instruction.md is present, so the SPEC is not standing in for it.
SIGN-001 / SIGN-002 / SIGN-003 are deprecated rows superseded by SIGN-004, which passes: no `[signoff]` table is present.

CMP-020: the `main` service carries `extra_hosts` and `ports` as well as `depends_on`, so it does not exist solely to express ordering. CMP-022 and reference/C C.6 (C12) require both keys on `main` and validate_task.py enforces them; CMP-020 is a convention row that CMP-022 supersedes.

DEP-011 is NOT-APPLICABLE: `[verifier].environment_mode` is `separate`, so the grader does not run in the agent image. The grader runtime is installed anyway at the grader-0.22.0 pins, which runtime_deps_lint.py (G55) confirms and DEP-004 exempts by name.
DEP-015 / DEP-017 / BP-005 are NOT-APPLICABLE: `[metadata].language` is `python`, so there is no compiled-language stage, no JRE and no build-only toolchain to separate.

ARCH-002 / ARCH-003 are NOT-APPLICABLE: every image is pinned by an explicit version tag rather than by a digest, which reference/C C.4 requires so one tag builds natively on both architectures. No digest is fabricated because none is used.

BP-004 is NOT-APPLICABLE: no build-time download carries a source-provided checksum. ENV-003 and ENV-004 are NOT-APPLICABLE: the Dockerfile declares no VOLUME and no ENTRYPOINT. SEC-003 is NOT-APPLICABLE: no source establishes non-root execution and every shipped reference environment runs as root.

The six-hat loop (Reader, Omission Auditor, Invention Prosecutor, Builder, Mechanic, Editor) ran over instruction.md alone and stopped on two consecutive clean passes. The first pass carried eighteen defects: eighteen `literal`-tagged items whose backticked endpoint values had no pinned row, two items using the word `test` inside the endpoints-surface name, four connector and pronoun violations and two grading words. All were repaired at the source and the second pass was clean. checklist_qc.py reports 619 items across ten sections, one unpinned value declared, and the coverage ledger reconciles with the body in every row.

Legal profile set for the (solo_founder, content-publishing) cell is P4-db-storage, and `[metadata].service_profile` declares exactly that. Global archetype uniqueness is the mint ledger's and cannot be decided from the code alone.

generate_instruction.md was read end to end before the brief was written, and its section-8 self-check was run over the emitted brief. The 2.9 stack draw, the 2.10 interaction draws and the L.6 direction are recorded as `draw:` lines in _spec/<code>/00-decisions.md; `design_direction` is `companion` per reference/L L.6.1 because a PRD was supplied. The brief carries no hex, no millisecond value and no cubic-bezier, and `## Build plan` is absent at this variant per 2.1.

The 'supplied source documents' rule governed the whole of Phase 1: 04-uiux-brief.md and the design half of 03-app-flow.md were derived from the companion section by section rather than from the draws, and the companion carry table in 00-decisions.md records where every one of its 25 sections landed.
